summary: Catawiki is online auction platform, founded in 2008. Type: private company. About 775 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 88% of its 8 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam online auction site for special objects (775 staff); 23 roles here, 96% in English, but the company is exploring a sale.

culture.text: Describes a flat structure where every role has a broad scope, plus development plans and mentorship.
Staff often studied at UvA, Groningen, Hanze, Erasmus or VU, in economics, business, art or marketing.
Hundreds of in-house experts review over 100,000 objects auctioned every week.
About 775 employees; some roles are fully remote for people in Germany or the Netherlands.

open.text: Catawiki B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
96% of its 23 jobs here don't require Dutch, and 13% mention visa or relocation support.
Has 5 internships and 2 entry-level roles open.

growth.text: Expanded its Catawiki Live feature to four new categories.
Appointed two new management board members for product and customer experience.

worth_knowing.text: Is exploring a possible sale and has hired Barclays to advise.
